data.title: Conditional / Trigger-Based Execution
data.summary: The sample gates its real behaviour behind a condition unrelated to anti-analysis evasion — a specific date, a target-specific identifier, a count threshold — executing its payload only once that condition is met.
data.description:
This differs from the anti-analysis guardrails covered elsewhere in intent, though the
mechanism can overlap: a logic bomb set to trigger on a future date, a check for a
specific domain-joined environment or hostname indicating a particular target, or a
counter requiring a minimum number of prior executions before escalating behaviour. The
common thread is a condition chosen for the attacker's operational purposes, not to defeat
an analyst.
data.recommendation:
* Recover and evaluate the exact condition rather than assuming anti-analysis intent; a date or target-identifier check indicates deliberate operational targeting or timing.
* Where a future-dated trigger is found, treat it as a logic bomb and remediate before the trigger date regardless of current inactivity.
* Correlate the condition against known campaign or target information; a hostname or domain check in particular may directly identify the intended victim.
data.short_recommendation: Recover the exact trigger condition; a date or target identifier indicates deliberate operational targeting, not anti-analysis.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Compared the current system date against a hardcoded future trigger date and withheld the destructive payload until it was reached.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Withheld payload execution until a hardcoded future date was reached, functioning as a logic bomb.
